rebuilt_from: prep/plan.draft.json (its topics used the video-to-speech population, which excludes text-conditioned synthesis; M02 silent-target-transfer and M07 V2S speaker conditioning do not apply to this task)

inherited.M01: Recorded voiced speech in existing corpora (Chem lectures, GRID, LRS2); no new training-time user action.
inherited.M02: Montreal Forced Aligner phoneme durations as training-only targets for the aligner, as in FastSpeech2-style dubbing systems.
inherited.M03: Decoder initialised from a pretrained ESPnet SpeechLM and fine-tuned jointly with the aligner; standard pretrain-then-adapt.
inherited.M04: Offline synthesis from given script text, lip video and a reference utterance; V2C/visual TTS task definition.
inherited.M05: AV-HuBERT lip embeddings at 25 fps from existing video.
inherited.M07: Reference speech prompt for voice cloning at use time; part of the V2C/visual TTS task definition.
inherited.M08: EnCodec 8-codebook 16 kHz tokens decoded to waveform, as in codec language models.
inherited.M11: Ground-truth recordings of Chem, GRID and LRS2 as references.
inherited.M13: Research implementation; no latency, size or cost reported.

topics.inclusion_rule: Studies that synthesize a speech waveform from talking-face or lip video together with text: the script given as input (visual TTS, automated video or movie dubbing) or text predicted by a lip reader and used to condition synthesis (text-aware video-to-speech). Boundary: plain video-to-speech without any text conditioning, talking-head generation (speech or text to face video), audio-visual recognition, and cascades that only run an off-the-shelf TTS on lip-read text without using the video in synthesis are excluded; versions of one study count once; design counts are full-text pattern counts (upper bound, related-work mentions included).
topics.pattern: movie dubbing|video dubbing|automated video dubbing|visual text-to-speech|Visual TTS mel|text-to-video alignment|text-aware video-to-speech|title=LipVoicer|VTP text|guided by lip reading
topics.metric: ASR WER of the synthesized speech

topics.inclusion_rule: Same population as M06 text-and-video-to-speech-decoder; classify from the full text how synthesized speech is evaluated: SyncNet lip-sync scores (LSE-C/LSE-D), length-weighted mel-cepstral distortion (MCD-DTW-SL), listener or opinion tests, ASR WER and speaker similarity. Boundary: a study counts under every protocol its text names (upper bound); versions once.
